Asset type: clean source photograph for an iPhone photo collage marketing website
Primary request: A photographic Chinese river-and-mountain landscape inspired by the Li River in Guangxi, China. Eye-level view from a quiet natural shoreline across a broad calm river, with staggered limestone karst hills receding into the distance.
Style/medium: convincing real-camera landscape photography with natural micro-detail, believable scale and credible geology.
Composition/framing: one standalone portrait photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio preferred, largest available portrait output. The broad calm water occupies the lower approximately 45 percent. Karst hills stagger across the middle distance and background; leave the surface readable and uncluttered.
Lighting/mood: soft sunrise haze, subtle warm sunlight grazing the rocky hills, peaceful natural atmosphere.
Color palette: restrained muted green-blue water and vegetation, pale warm morning light, no dramatic color grading.
Materials/textures: realistic weathered limestone cliffs, irregular vegetation, faint natural ripples and softly broken reflections.
Constraints: AI-generated inspired landscape, not an exact geolocation or documentary record. Clean full-bleed photo only; no people, text, labels, logos, watermark, border, frame, UI, collage, boats, buildings, or roads.
Avoid: fantasy peaks, improbable needle mountains, magical floating mountains, CGI, 3D rendering, illustration, painterly textures, excessive haze, oversaturated HDR, artificial sharpness.
